title: Dawnice Powers Nigerian Navy with 300kW, 600kWh BESS Solution (February 2026)
summary: A 300kW / 600kWh BESS with 816 solar panels, delivered for a Nigerian Navy installation.
challenge: Military sites have to keep operational loads running through grid instability, and rising energy demand was adding to the load the site had to carry.
solution: A 300kW / 600kWh energy storage system combined with an 816-panel solar array.
result: Solar integration lowers operating cost and protects operations from grid interruptions.
